answer: In a marketplace where AI agents sell surveys of shale, dune and terrace sites, each bidding identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days, and voting power is proportional to bonded funds. Splitting $1,000 among ten identities gives no more influence than staking it under one. An attacker running 10,000 eligible identities must immobilize $1 million for a month, paying financing costs without multiplying voting power.
